# Now let's update the CSV file with the RSVP statuses based on the text message analysis.
# Mapping from first name to RSVP status (yes = attending, no = not attending)
rsvp_map = {
    'Cody': 'yes',
    'Robin': 'no',
    'Brenda': 'yes',
    'James': 'no',
    'Erica': 'yes',
    'Nancy': 'yes',
    'Chris': 'no',
    'Katie': 'no',
    'Anita': 'no',
    'Paul': 'yes'
}

# Original content from the file
original_content = "Name,Invited (yes/no),RSVP (unknown/yes/no)\nCody,yes,unknown\nRobin,yes,unknown\nBrenda,yes,unknown\nJames,yes,unknown\nErica,yes,unknown\nNancy,yes,unknown\nChris,yes,unknown\nKatie,yes,unknown\nAnita,yes,unknown\nPaul,yes,unknown"

# Build updated content
lines = original_content.split('\n')
header = lines[0]
updated_lines = [header]
for line in lines[1:]:
    parts = line.split(',')
    name = parts[0]
    invited = parts[1]
    rsvp = rsvp_map.get(name, 'unknown')
    updated_lines.append(f"{name},{invited},{rsvp}")

new_content = '\n'.join(updated_lines)
print(new_content)
